title: PHANTOM GRID Automotive HPC Swarm & 5Gbps High-Throughput Matrix
full_script: PHANTOM GRID deploys automotive central high-performance computing domain controller swarm. Concurrently aggregating 100 channels across 50 CAN-FD buses and 50 SOME/IP Ethernet streams. Heterogeneous multi-core parallel engine achieves sustained 5.00 Gbps line-rate throughput. Zero packet loss and deterministic sub-15 microsecond latency ensure instantaneous vehicle control. All benchmark executions are cryptographically signed with SHA-256 and exposed via Model Context Protocol.
